cim: Trusteeship in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Building the Future Fiduciary
cim_eredeti: Trusteeship in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Building the Future Fiduciary
szoveg_eredeti:
As artificial intelligence becomes embedded in professional services, fiduciary firms have an opportunity to rethink how information, processes, controls and people work together. AI in fiduciary services could reduce administrative effort, strengthen oversight and make reporting more efficient. The challenge is not simply automating existing processes, but designing an operating model that improves capacity and service while maintaining reliable data, appropriate authority and human accountability.

The final article in this three-part series explores how trustees can develop an AI-enabled fiduciary operating model across information management, governance, controls and professional skills. It examines how automation can support monitoring and decision-making while preserving clear execution responsibility and underlying expertise. For boards and management teams, the priority is aligning AI strategy with the firm’s target market, risk profile and operating model rather than adopting individual tools in isolation.
